meta.title: Download Legal Masr
meta.subtitle: Choose the version that matches your operating system. All downloads are free.

actions.mobile: Legal Masr is a desktop app. Open this page on your computer to download it.

windows.title: Windows
windows.desc: Installer and portable version for Windows.
windows.note: If Windows SmartScreen shows a warning, click “More info” and then “Run anyway”.

linux.title: Linux
linux.desc: Packages for Debian-based and Red Hat-based distributions, plus a universal AppImage.
linux.note: After downloading, open a terminal in the folder that contains the file and run the command shown on the card.

windows-installer.name: Windows installer (.exe)
windows-installer.desc: The recommended option. Installs the app and adds a Start menu shortcut.

windows-portable.name: Portable version (.zip)
windows-portable.desc: No installation needed. Extract the folder and run the app from anywhere.

linux-deb.name: Debian / Ubuntu (.deb)
linux-deb.desc: For Debian, Ubuntu, Linux Mint and similar distributions.

linux-rpm.name: Fedora / openSUSE (.rpm)
linux-rpm.desc: For Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL and similar distributions.

linux-appimage.name: Universal (AppImage)
linux-appimage.desc: Works on most distributions without installing. Make it executable and run it.

macos-dmg.name: macOS (.dmg)
macos-dmg.desc: Open the disk image and drag the app to your Applications folder.
